about.title: About
about.short_description: Back-end software developer with +9 years of experience

description.1: I am a Data Scientist, Strategist, and Data Analyst with over 9 years of experience in backend development.
description.2: Python expert with nearly a decade of experience, I design robust, high-performance, and maintainable APIs in complex environments.
description.3: I also have strong expertise in KDB+/Q for real-time data analysis, enabling me to deliver fast and accurate insights to trading teams.
description.4: Specialized in the finance and trading industries, I have a deep understanding of the constraints and dynamics of these critical environments.
description.5: My curiosity drives me to explore new paradigms thoroughly while maintaining a strong focus on software quality, architecture, and system scalability.
